# Backend contract

Endpoint: `https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxerPSjB0ZGAdopq-dCz7SYkKXwAMI9mRkA1H366MJm6DDWneC7ulm6zTdfLH8pnCghFw/exec`

Front-end sends `POST` with `Content-Type: text/plain;charset=utf-8` containing JSON.

## `generateVoiceAcapella`

Required response can include any of:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "wavBase64": "...",
  "mp3Base64": "...",
  "profile": {}
}
```

## `exportAudio`

Request includes:

```json
{
  "action": "exportAudio",
  "targetFormat": "mp3",
  "sourceFormat": "wav",
  "audioBase64": "..."
}
```

Response should include:

```json
{ "ok": true, "audioBase64": "..." }
```

Unknown assets must remain blocked. Instrumental output must remain disabled.
